name: Traxxas Slash 2WD (1/10 short course truck)
description: 1/10 rear-drive Ackermann chassis. The motor, ESC and steering servo are separate parts.
notes: Published: wheelbase 335 mm, track 296 mm (as listed; it equals the overall width), length 568 mm, width 296 mm, height 214 mm, RTR mass 2.16 kg without battery. finalDriveRatio 15.3 = stock 16T/90T gearing x 2.72 transmission from the manual gear chart (the product page says 12.58, which matches neither listed pinion). Estimates (not published): mass 1790 g = 2.16 kg minus the stock motor (240 g), ESC, servo and receiver, which are separate parts here; wheel radius 55 mm from about 110 mm SCT tyres; max steering angle 28 deg (typical 1/10 SCT, 25-32); steering linkage ratio 0.7 (so 1000-2000 us on the servo gives roughly full lock); centre of gravity 100 mm high with a 40/60 front/rear split; mount point positions from the body-shell geometry.
